content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IWAI Specialist (Legal) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.iwai.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IWAI Specialist (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the IWAI Specialist (Legal) recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Specialist (Legal) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognized University to be eligible for the Specialist (Legal) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Specialist (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Specialist (Legal) post is between 25 years and 63 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Specialist (Legal) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Specialist (Legal) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month, or as per the last pay drawn minus pension plus entitled allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IWAI Specialist (Legal) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Specialist (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The Specialist (Legal) post is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Specialist (Legal) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Specialist (Legal) post announced in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) located?
faq.answer: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) is located in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with a pincode of 201301.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Specialist (Legal) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Specialist (Legal) role primarily involves an application screening. Further stages, if any, will be detailed in the official notification.
